Umlegung, Auswertung, Protokoll ist nicht notwendig
if Visum.Net.AttValue("c_Schritt")==-1: # Initialisierung Umlegung bleibt an Visum.Procedures.Operations.ItemByKey(Visum.Net.AttValue("C_VFS_NFM_lesen")).SetAttValue("Active",0) #NFM lesen # Velo-Umlegung aus Visum.Procedures.Operations.ItemByKey(Visum.Net.AttValue("C_VFS_UmlVelo_P")).SetAttValue("Active",0) #Umlegung abschalten Visum.Procedures.Operations.ItemByKey(Visum.Net.AttValue("C_VFS_UmlVelo_F")).SetAttValue("Active",0) #Umlegung abschalten #Protokolldatei sichern aus Visum.Procedures.Operations.ItemByKey(Visum.Net.AttValue("C_VFS_ProtSchreiben")).SetAttValue("Active",0) #Auswertung abschalten Visum.Procedures.Operations.ItemByKey(Visum.Net.AttValue("C_VFS_AuswBlock")).SetAttValue("Active",0) Visum.Procedures.Operations.ItemByKey(Visum.Net.AttValue("C_VFS_AUSWSKRIPT")).SetAttValue("Active",0) #Auswerteskript abschalten
else: # Umlegung, ohne Kenngrößen schreiben, Protokoll, Auswertung Visum.Procedures.Operations.ItemByKey(Visum.Net.AttValue("C_VFS_KGM_berechnen_V_P")).SetAttValue("Active",0) #KGM berechnen abschalten Visum.Procedures.Operations.ItemByKey(Visum.Net.AttValue("C_VFS_KGM_berechnen_V_F")).SetAttValue("Active",0) #KGM berechnen abschalten Visum.Procedures.Operations.ItemByKey(Visum.Net.AttValue("C_VFS_KGM_bearbeiten")).SetAttValue("Active",0) #KGM scheiben abschalten Visum.Procedures.Operations.ItemByKey(Visum.Net.AttValue("C_VFS_KGM_schreiben")).SetAttValue("Active",0) #KGM scheiben abschalten Visum.Procedures.Operations.ItemByKey(Visum.Net.AttValue("C_VFS_InitUml2")).SetAttValue("Active",0) #Umlegungsinit. abschalten

################################################################################################################## # # Skript zum Einlesen der Nachfragematrizen, die zur Modellform gehören # # PTV TC AnLü # ##################################################################################################################
# Bibliotheksimport--------------------------------- import os
# Nutzereinstellungen ------------------------------ #Angabe der CODES der einzulesenden Matritzen ohne Modellfrom und Endung matrixlist_code =["VELO_P", "VELO_F", "EBIKE_P", "EBIKE_F"] #Bsp. Form: "TTC PPS", "LUW FGV"
# Berechnung ---------------------------------------- modellform = Visum.Net.AttValue("SZENARIOCODE") #os.path.basename(Visum.UserPreferences.DocumentName)
for matrix_code in matrixlist_code: matrix_no = Visum.Net.Matrices.ItemsByRef(f"Matrix([CODE] = \"{matrix_code}\")").GetMultipleAttributes(['NO']) matrix_no = int(matrix_no[0][0]) matrix = Visum.Net.Matrices.ItemByKey(matrix_no) matrix_name = f"{matrix_no}_{matrix_code}_{modellform}.mtx" matrix_name = matrix_name.replace(" ","_") matrix.Open(matrix_name, ReadAdditive=False)
# Finalisierung ------------------------------------ #nicht erforderlich

MATRIXFORMULAPARA.FORMULA: Matrix([NAME] = "TT0 VELO") := if(Matrix([NAME] = "t0 V_P") = 999999 & Matrix([NAME] = "t0 V_F") = 999999, 999999, if(Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_F") = 0, (Matrix([NAME] = "t0 V_P") + Matrix([NAME] = "t0 V_F")) / 2, (Matrix([NAME] = "t0 V_P") * Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_P") + Matrix([NAME] = "t0 V_F") * Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_F")) / (Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_F"))))

Matrix([NAME] = "DIS VELO") := if(Matrix([CODE] = "DIS" & [DSEGCODE] = "V_P") = 999999 & Matrix([CODE] = "DIS" & [DSEGCODE] = "V_F") = 999999, 999999, if(Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_F") = 0, (Matrix([CODE] = "DIS" & [DSEGCODE] = "V_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "DIS" & [DSEGCODE] = "V_F")) / 2, (Matrix([CODE] = "DIS" & [DSEGCODE] = "V_P") * Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "DIS" & [DSEGCODE] = "V_F") * Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_F")) / (Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_F"))))

Matrix([NAME] = "IMP VELO") := if(Matrix([CODE] = "IMP" & [DSEGCODE] = "V_P") = 999999 & Matrix([CODE] = "IMP" & [DSEGCODE] = "V_F") = 999999, 999999, if(Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_F") = 0, (Matrix([CODE] = "IMP" & [DSEGCODE] = "V_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "IMP" & [DSEGCODE] = "V_F")) / 2, (Matrix([CODE] = "IMP" & [DSEGCODE] = "V_P") * Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "IMP" & [DSEGCODE] = "V_F") * Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_F")) / (Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "VELO_F"))))

Matrix([NAME] = "TT0 EBIKE") := if(Matrix([NAME] = "t0 V+_P") = 999999 & Matrix([NAME] = "t0 V+_F") = 999999, 999999, if(Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_F") = 0, (Matrix([NAME] = "t0 V+_P") + Matrix([NAME] = "t0 V+_F")) / 2, (Matrix([NAME] = "t0 V+_P") * Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_P") + Matrix([NAME] = "t0 V+_F") * Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_F")) / (Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_F"))))

Matrix([NAME] = "DIS EBIKE") := if(Matrix([CODE] = "DIS" & [DSEGCODE] = "V+_P") = 999999 & Matrix([CODE] = "DIS" & [DSEGCODE] = "V+_F") = 999999, 999999, if(Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_F") = 0, (Matrix([CODE] = "DIS" & [DSEGCODE] = "V+_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "DIS" & [DSEGCODE] = "V+_F")) / 2, (Matrix([CODE] = "DIS" & [DSEGCODE] = "V+_P") * Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "DIS" & [DSEGCODE] = "V+_F") * Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_F")) / (Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_F"))))

Matrix([NAME] = "IMP EBIKE") := if(Matrix([CODE] = "IMP" & [DSEGCODE] = "V+_P") = 999999 & Matrix([CODE] = "IMP" & [DSEGCODE] = "V+_F") = 999999, 999999, if(Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_F") = 0, (Matrix([CODE] = "IMP" & [DSEGCODE] = "V+_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "IMP" & [DSEGCODE] = "V+_F")) / 2, (Matrix([CODE] = "IMP" & [DSEGCODE] = "V+_P") * Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "IMP" & [DSEGCODE] = "V+_F") * Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_F")) / (Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_P") + Matrix([CODE] = "EBIKE_F"))))

################################################################################################################## # # Skript zum Einlesen der externen Matritzen, die zur Modellform gehören # # PTV TC AnLü # ##################################################################################################################
# Bibliotheksimport--------------------------------- import os
# Nutzereinstellungen ------------------------------ #Angabe der CODES der einzulesenden Matritzen ohne Modellfrom und Endung matrixlist_code =["TT0", "DIS", "IMP"] #Bsp. Form: "TTC PPS", "LUW FGV" nseglist_code = ["V_P", "V+_P", "V_F", "V+_F"]
# Berechnung ---------------------------------------- modellform = Visum.Net.AttValue("SZENARIOCODE") #os.path.basename(Visum.UserPreferences.DocumentName).split("_")[2]
